newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas called higher, Gulf cash firms.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas called higher, Gulf cash firms.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open higher Wednesday following a stronger ACCESS session and early talk of firmer cash, sources said.
July over-the-counter trade ranged from $2.13 to $2.145 per mmBtu after settling Tuesday at $2.103.
On ACCESS, July last traded 3.6 cents firmer at $2.139.
Cash prices at Henry Hub were talked about four cents higher at $2.13-2.16 per mmBtu.
"It looks like it's going to push out. It looks like it's going to crush $2.15-2.16," one trader said, noting further support was pegged at $2.18 and $2.21.
After $2.21, further resistance in July was pegged at $2.25, $2.37-2.38 and the contract high of $2.44. Support was seen at $2.08, and then at $2.05 and $2.00.

In Tuesday's cash, Gulf Coast prices fell 10 cents to about $2.05-2.10. Midcon pipes were talked about five cents lower around $2. New York city gate gas also was talked down five to 10 cents to the high-$2.30s.
Injection estimates for today's American Gas Association storage report have ranged from 69 to 88 bcf, versus a gain of 88 bcf a year ago.
